title: Distinct lifted literal indices
statement: Let $n$ and $a$ be natural numbers, and let a DNF term on $n$ variables have pairwise distinct literal indices. After lifting its literals to the variable set of size $n+a$, their indices remain pairwise distinct.
hypotheses_covered: A DNF term on $n$ variables, whose literal indices are pairwise distinct
